title: I Made an Open-ended Trivia Game
author: Ajudgi
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I started developing my game, Ajudgi, in March 2025 and released it in the Google Play and Apple Apps stores just about a year later. The features open-ended questions that are judged by various AI personalities. Players earn XP and level up, unlocking new judges, new questions, etc.

I used Claude Pro for the first 6 months or so, but kept running out of tokens, so I upgraded to Claude Max for the last half of development. Max was a godsend and made things go so much faster! While I was still writing/editing code as much as I could, using Claude Max allowed me to finally get over the hump and spring to the finish.

  
I suppose the biggest secret, which isn't much of a secret at all, is just how much work is needed AFTER release. Fixing bugs, adding features, stuff like that.

  
One thing I am VERY proud of is that I have actually been able to create a way to have limited-time events that are community driven. While my playerbase is small right now, it's growing and I can't be happier :)

  
This month's limited event is based on the World Cup where users need to impress a football/soccer hooligan with their answers on questions specifically about the World Cup!

  
If you want to take a look, you can download the game here: 

[https://ajudgi.web.app/download](https://ajudgi.web.app/download)

  
Would also love all of your thoughts on the game and I'd be happy to answer any questions about its development.
